ordering: hard-negative gates execute before the wider positive matrix

hard_negative_phase.setup: physically create a ready candidate with immutable nonnegative qrot vector A; prepare attribution for that same candidate using different immutable nonnegative qrot vector B; commit the original candidate through the real generic accepted-commit receipt
hard_negative_phase.required: the attribution layer must not publish an OK receipt carrying B-derived transpiration for an A-derived physical candidate
hard_negative_phase.failure_meaning: silent process-attribution corruption while generic transaction mass remains correct

hard_negative_phase.required: no attribution receipt before accepted generic commit receipt

variants: wrong interval outside shared numeric identity tolerance

positive_phase: non-root coexisting mass_out remains outside the attributed amount
solver-retry/substep completion with one immutable outer-interval qrot
mass_rule: actual-transpiration attribution is a named subset of already-booked transaction total_out and is never added to total_out
publication_rule: only postcommit receipts may become authoritative
early_exit_rule: after any hard-negative fail-open the remaining entries are recorded UNRUN; they are not classified as failures
